infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TripSync uses your location to show it to your group members on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TripSync uses your location to show it to your group members on the map.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TripSync uses the camera to scan invite QR codes and capture photos and videos for chat.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: TripSync uses the microphone to record audio for video clips you share in chat.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TripSync needs access to your photos so you can choose a profile picture, cover image, or share photos and videos in chat.
